name: Increasing a load's energy re-solves the schedule

planSteps.description: Open the app and wait for the initial solve to finish.
Read the EV charger's energy figure. It starts at exactly 12 kWh.
Press the '+' button on the EV charger once and wait for the app to finish re-solving.
Verify the EV charger's energy figure now reads exactly 12.5 kWh. A single press moves it by exactly 0.5 kWh.
Verify the saving figure or the scheduled bill total has changed from the value before the press, which proves the app re-solved the schedule rather than only relabelling the load.
Press the '-' button on the EV charger once and wait for the app to finish re-solving.
Verify the EV charger's energy figure reads exactly 12 kWh again.
